messages:
maria: Heads-up — spotted a mismatch in the KB glossary entry for `autoscaling`. The page still references the old Reserved Capacity tiers and a dead shortlink.
ajay: Can you paste the link? I can take a quick look and file a tiny PR.
maria: https://kb.internal.redwood.com/glossary#autoscaling — the shortlink at the top 301s to a deleted page. Also the example JSON still shows `tier: reserved_v1` which doesn't exist.
olivia: ack. That shortlink was rotated last quarter. Owner for glossary was supposed to be @kevin, cc-ing him.
kevin: thanks, pinged. i'm tied up in a release but can do a sweep tonight. if someone opens a small PR i can merge in the morning.
maria: i started a draft branch with the shortlink fix and the JSON tweak. only change is replacing the shortlink and `reserved_v1` -> `reserved`. PR: https://git.internal.redwood.com/docs/kb/merge_requests/1245
ajay: nice — left one inline comment on the example about adding a note on rollout policy. tiny change.
maria: oh also the glossary page has an orphaned inline anchor `#reserved-capacity-overview` that 404s from other docs. quick grep command if anyone wants to run local scan:

```
rg "\#reserved-capacity-overview" -g "docs/**/*" --hidden
```

olivia: nice command. docs-bot FYI — do we have an automated scan for orphan anchors that we can run against the staging site?
docs-bot: periodic-anchor-scan scheduled weekly. Last run: 2026-03-15. Found 9 orphan anchors; this glossary anchor is not yet flagged because the pages it links from are in a different namespace. Recommend manual check.
kevin: thanks for the flag. i'll claim the glossary page as owner and push the small PR change + a redirect for the old shortlink. If someone from docs team can approve the PR that'd speed merge.
ajay: i can approve now. also suggest adding a one-liner in the page metadata: `maintainers: kevin, olivia` so ownership is clear.
maria: done — added metadata to the branch. ran the build locally, looks fine.
kevin: merging tonight, will add a tiny redirect rule in the CDN config and a follow-up task to update any consuming pages. Thanks for the ping :thumbsup:
maria: thanks everyone. putting a brief note in the docs-owners board: "glossary autoscaling - owner: kevin - fixed shortlink + example JSON" so we have a trail.
olivia: sweet. if any other orphans show up from the grep, drop them here and i'll triage during docs office hours tomorrow.
kevin: closing loop — will post the deployed URL here when live.
